notes: Qal's perfect 3fs slot is attested identically (same clause, "mine eye is consumed/wasted with grief") in both Ps.6.8 and Ps.31.10; Ps.6.8 kept as citation per the usual duplicate-slot tie-break. Ps.31.11 (3cp, "my bones are wasted away") is a separate slot and is kept independently.

Gloss collision: "waste away" (exact) matches the existing מסס (H4549) root gloss and a clause of זוב (H2100, "flow; waste away") -- disambiguating search alias added. Also overlaps כחש (H3584)'s piel stem_gloss "waste away", stem-level on their side, no alias needed for that one.
